name: Discord Staff
description: Distinguishes confirmed full-time or contracted Discord employees and internal operations personnel.
earning_method: Become an employed staff member at Discord Inc. Awarded by Discord internal directory administration. Automatically revoked upon departure.

name: Partnered Server Owner
description: Awarded to owners of active, high-engagement communities accepted into the Discord Partner Program.
earning_method: Apply and obtain approval for an eligible community server. If ownership is transferred, the badge transfers to the new server owner. New public applications were paused/re-evaluated after October 5, 2023.

name: HypeSquad Events Coordinator
description: Recognizes community leaders who host or organize live in-person gaming conventions, tournaments, and local meetups.
earning_method: Formerly applied through the HypeSquad Events application portal with proof of hosting local conventions or tournaments. Currently paused for new applicants.

name: Discord Bug Hunter (Tier 1)
tier_threshold: Verified non-duplicate bug reports on Discord Testers
description: Awarded to community testers who regularly discover, accurately report, and triage bugs on the official Discord Testers community.
earning_method: Participate in the Discord Testers bug reporting community (via Discord Testers or Bug Hunter portal), successfully report valid and reproducible bugs, and reach the required community threshold.

name: HypeSquad Bravery
tier_threshold: Complete in-app personality quiz resulting in House Bravery
description: Represents membership in the House of Bravery, one of three community factions selected through the in-client quiz.
earning_method: Go to User Settings > HypeSquad in the desktop or web client, take the 5-question personality aptitude test, and be assigned to Bravery.

name: HypeSquad Brilliance
tier_threshold: Complete in-app personality quiz resulting in House Brilliance
description: Represents membership in the House of Brilliance, focusing on patience, discipline, and tactical thinking.
earning_method: Go to User Settings > HypeSquad in the desktop or web client, take the 5-question personality test, and match Brilliance answers.

name: HypeSquad Balance
tier_threshold: Complete in-app personality quiz resulting in House Balance
description: Represents membership in the House of Balance, embodying harmony, stability, and mutual cooperation.
earning_method: Go to User Settings > HypeSquad in the desktop or web client, complete the 5-question questionnaire, and match Balance outcomes.

name: Early Supporter
description: Historical commemorative badge awarded to early patrons who purchased Nitro before the introduction of Nitro tiers.
earning_method: Required a successful transaction or gift redemption for Discord Nitro prior to Wednesday, October 10, 2018 at 7:20:00 PM PDT.

name: Discord Bug Hunter (Tier 2)
tier_threshold: Distinguished exceptional contribution on Discord Testers
description: Discord's highest technical testing accolade, awarded to top contributors who uncover critical vulnerabilities and triage complex regressions.
earning_method: Granted directly by Discord QA leadership for extraordinary bug hunting achievements, exploit discoveries, and exceptional triage assistance.

name: Early Verified Bot Developer
description: Commemorates developers whose applications reached 75+ servers and completed identity verification before the verification program overhaul.
earning_method: Required owning a verified Discord bot with approved government ID verification prior to August 19, 2020.

name: Moderator Programs Alumni
description: Recognizes community managers who passed the Discord Moderator Academy exam and served in the Discord Certified Moderator community.
earning_method: Required studying the Discord Moderator Academy curriculum, passing the comprehensive exam, and maintaining good standing in the official DMC community before program restructuring.

name: Active Developer
description: Awarded to developers maintaining active applications that execute global application commands (slash commands) on Discord.
earning_method: Own at least one active application that executed any global command within the last 30 days, visit Developer Portal > Active Developer Badge, select your app and support server, and claim the badge.

name: Originally Known As (Legacy Username)
description: Displays a user's original legacy username and 4-digit discriminator (e.g. 'Originally User#1234') following the 2023 unique username rollout.
earning_method: Awarded automatically to accounts that converted from the legacy discriminator system to unique handles during the 2023 rollout. Can be hidden in User Settings.

name: Discord Nitro Subscriber
tier_threshold: Active Nitro or Nitro Classic subscription
description: Displayed on profile cards of accounts with an active paid Discord Nitro subscription.
earning_method: Subscribe to Discord Nitro via desktop, web, or mobile app.

name: Discord Nitro Basic
description: Denotes an active subscription to the lower-cost Discord Nitro Basic tier ($2.99/mo).
earning_method: Subscribe to Discord Nitro Basic in User Settings > Nitro.

name: Nitro Tenure: Bronze
description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 1 month.
earning_method: Subscribe to Nitro and maintain the subscription past 30 continuous days.

name: Nitro Tenure: Silver
description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 3 months.
earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 3 months.

name: Nitro Tenure: Gold
description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 6 months.
earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 6 months.

name: Nitro Tenure: Platinum
tier_threshold: 12 continuous months of Discord Nitro (1 Year)
description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 12 months (1 year).
earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 1 full year.

name: Nitro Tenure: Diamond
tier_threshold: 24 continuous months of Discord Nitro (2 Years)
description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 24 months (2 years).
earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 2 full years.

name: Nitro Tenure: Emerald
tier_threshold: 36 continuous months of Discord Nitro (3 Years)
description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 36 months (3 years).
earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 3 full years.

name: Nitro Tenure: Ruby
tier_threshold: 60 continuous months of Discord Nitro (5 Years)
description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 60 months (5 years).
earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 5 full years.

name: Nitro Tenure: Opal
tier_threshold: 72+ continuous months of Discord Nitro (6+ Years)
description: Discord's ultimate subscription longevity honor, awarded for over 72 continuous months (6+ years) of active Nitro subscription.
earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 6 or more years without lapse beyond grace period.

name: Server Booster: Level 1 (1 Month)
description: Initial server boosting milestone badge displayed on user profiles and in the server booster list.
earning_method: Apply a Server Boost to any guild and maintain it active.

name: Server Booster: Level 2 (2 Months)
description: Second server boosting milestone, updating the jewel insignia design.
earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 2 months.

name: Server Booster: Level 3 (3 Months)
description: Third server boosting milestone.
earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 3 months.

name: Server Booster: Level 4 (6 Months)
description: Fourth server boosting milestone, featuring crystalline facets.
earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 6 months.

name: Server Booster: Level 5 (9 Months)
description: Fifth server boosting milestone.
earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 9 months.

name: Server Booster: Level 6 (1 Year)
description: Sixth server boosting milestone celebrating 1 full year of continuous boosting loyalty.
earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 12 months.

name: Server Booster: Level 7 (15 Months)
description: Seventh server boosting milestone.
earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 15 months.

name: Server Booster: Level 8 (18 Months)
description: Eighth server boosting milestone.

name: Supports Commands
description: Indicates that an application utilizes Discord's official slash command and contextual interaction architecture.
earning_method: Register at least one application command via Discord's REST API endpoint (/commands).

name: Uses AutoMod
description: Awarded to security and moderation bots that have created over 100 active AutoMod rules across servers.
earning_method: Implement Discord's AutoMod API and maintain at least 100 active configured AutoMod rules across guilds.

name: Server Has App Premium
description: Appears on apps and bot profiles in servers where a paid subscription or monetization SKU has been purchased through Discord Premium Apps.
earning_method: Users in a server purchase an official In-App Purchase SKU for that application via Discord's native billing system.

name: Partnered Server
description: Insignia rendered on server headers and discovery cards designating an officially Partnered Discord guild.
earning_method: Achieve and maintain Discord Partner status for the guild.

name: Verified Server
description: Green/white verification checkmark on server headers for officially verified game studios, publishers, and recognized organizations.
earning_method: Submit official verification request with corporate identity and domain verification.

name: Official Discord Staff Server
description: Official badge reserved for internal and corporate Discord servers owned and administered by Discord staff.
earning_method: Internal corporate infrastructure only.

name: Community Server
description: Denotes that a guild has enabled Community features (welcome screen, announcement channels, AutoMod, and stage channels).
earning_method: Enable Community in Server Settings.

name: Discoverable Public Server
description: Insignia for servers listed in public Server Discovery.
earning_method: Meet Server Discovery requirements (1,000+ members, safety rules, no NSFW, etc.) and enable discovery in settings.

name: Boosted Server (Level 0)
tier_threshold: At least 1 boost, but under Level 1 threshold

earning_method: Receive 1 boost on the server.

name: Boosted Server (Level 1)
description: Indicates the server has attained Boost Level 1 unlocking 50 extra emoji slots, 720p 60fps Go Live, 128 Kbps audio, and custom invite background.
earning_method: Accumulate and maintain 2 active server boosts.

name: Boosted Server (Level 2)

name: Boosted Server (Level 3)

earning_method: Accumulate and maintain 14 active server boosts.

name: Server Owner Crown
